title: feat(console): a percent field with percentDisplay plain shows the percentage with no progress bar
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoGafurAzVV5LSc7XjvKnbpc)_

Fixes #28255

Refs #27973

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:百分比字段声明 `percentDisplay: 'plain'` 时,控制台只显示百分比数字,不再画进度条;列表、记录页字段、头部高亮、快速查看、相关列表、画廊卡片全部生效。字段设计器为 percent 字段新增 Bar / Plain 选项。
- **为什么改**:赢单概率、活动转化率这类数值是比率不是进度,画成进度条会误导;HotCRM 的 `crm_opportunity.probability` 和活动比率字段一直显示进度条。契约在 #28222 已声明,本 PR 补上渲染端。
- **风险与回滚**:只影响写了 `plain` 的字段;未写或写 `bar` 的字段显示不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR,无数据迁移。
- **先看**:① `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx`(`PercentCellRenderer` 的 `plain` 分支)② `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridGenerateColumns.tsx`(三条列路径各复制一次)③ `packages/spec/liveness/field.json`(`percentDisplay` 行转 live)。
- **两分钟验证**:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/src/__tests__/PercentCellRenderer.percentDisplay-28255.test.tsx`,预期 5 个用例全绿(`plain` 无 progressbar,只有 `25%`)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The percent cell reads the key.** `PercentCellRenderer` (`ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx`) returns the formatted percentage alone when `field.percentDisplay === 'plain'`. Absent or `bar` keeps the bar, the renderer default the describe names. Storage (`max`), width (`scale`) and locale are read exactly as before, above the branch. Only the literal `plain` turns the bar off: the spec refuses any other value, so there is no second spelling to accept.
- **Every relay site copies it beside `useGrouping`** — the same seven sites the `useGrouping` liveness row names:
  - `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridGenerateColumns.tsx` — the three configured-column paths (ListColumn objects, string columns, inline rows with a `fields` projection);
  - `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/fieldEnrichment.ts` — `ENRICHED_FIELD_METADATA_KEYS`, shared by `DetailSection` and `HeaderHighlight`;
  - `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordDetailPanel.tsx` (`buildRecordDetailFields`), `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` (`effectiveColumns`), `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ObjectGallery.tsx` (`buildEnrichedField`).
- **Spec rows the card names, nothing else in `packages/spec`:**
  - `field.form.ts` gains the `percentDisplay` row: a select over `bar` / `plain`, `visibleWhen: "data.type == 'percent'"`, no default, so an untouched row writes nothing.
  - The `percentDisplay` omit row in `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts` (added by #28222) goes.
  - `liveness/field.json`: the row flips `planned` → `live`, with `evidence` (the renderer read) and `producer` naming the seven relay sites the way the `useGrouping` row does. The describe (and its TSDoc) drops the not-yet-read clause. Regenerated: `content/docs/references/**` (three pages, the describe) and `liveness/state-counts/field.md` (live 100 → 101, planned 9 → 8).
- Changeset `.changeset/28255-percent-display-plain.md`, all `patch`.

**Clause-② measured on the diff: `no`.** The accepted set is unchanged (no schema edit; `check:authorable-surface` green), and the declaration surface is unchanged (`check:api-surface` green against an unmodified `api-surface/`; `ENRICHED_FIELD_METADATA_KEYS` is not exported from `@object-ui/plugin-detail`'s entry). The form row offers a key the schema already accepted, and the liveness flip records a reader; neither widens what parses or what the package entries declare. **Metadata-protocol: `none`**: what an author can write and what it means are unchanged; the renderer now honours it.
- **Surface note, accepted by the seat:** the new form row is a declared row, so its label and help text land in the `platform-objects` metadata-forms catalogs and `pnpm check:i18n` went red on it (7 bundles drifted). `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/{en,zh-CN,ja-JP,es-ES}.metadata-forms.generated.ts` (+16 lines) are regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`, and the three translated locales are hand-translated, so no source-hash entry is left behind. That is the only file outside the order's surface.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/fields/src/__tests__/PercentCellRenderer.percentDisplay-28255.test.tsx` — `plain` draws no `progressbar` and prints `25%`; `plain` keeps the declared storage and width (`max: 100`, `scale: 1` → `33.3%`); `bar` and absent keep the bar (control); a blank value is still the empty face.
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/gridPercentDisplay-28255.test.tsx` — each of the three configured-column paths, plus the auto-generated columns as the reference face; a same-shape control field with no key keeps its bar.
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/percentDisplayRelay-28255.test.tsx` — `DetailSection` and `HeaderHighlight` (the enrichment key list), `RecordDetailPanel` with no data source (the panel's own copy is the only road), `RelatedList`'s cell bag; one control bar per surface.
- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ObjectGallery.percentDisplay-28255.test.tsx` — the gallery card.

## Acceptance notes

- The read is on the field, whatever its type: `PercentCellRenderer` also draws `progress` and textual fields promoted by `format: 'percent'`. The spec describes the key for `percent`, and the form row is gated to `percent`; a `progress` field that carried `plain` would also drop its bar. Not widened in the spec, not refused in the renderer.
- The record History tab (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/auditHistoryDisplay.ts`) also copies `useGrouping`, but it formats text only and never draws the percent cell or its bar, so it is not a `percentDisplay` relay site and is unchanged.
- `@object-ui/types`' `PercentFieldMetadata` does not declare `percentDisplay` (it was outside the order's surface), so the grid, panel and related-list sites read it the way they read `scale`, through `as any`. Declaring it there (typed from `SpecField['percentDisplay']`, as `NumberFieldMetadata.useGrouping` is) would let those sites drop the casts.
- The `useGrouping` liveness row's `producer` still names `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx#generateColumns`; the column builder now lives in `objectGridGenerateColumns.tsx`, which is what the new `percentDisplay` row names. The path still resolves, so `check:liveness` is green; noted, not touched.

## Verification

The full readings below were taken at `7faff9ec` (based on `origin/main` 6285203d). Head `988c264c` then merges seven newer `main` commits (clean; none touches `ui/`) and regenerates the three reference-doc pages the merge driver deferred (`main`'s `currencyConfig.homeAmount` rows). Scoped re-checks at `988c264c`: spec `src/data/field src/system/metadata-form src/data/form` 22 files / 692 tests passed, `check:liveness`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:api-surface`, `check:generated` (14 of 14 current after `--fix`), `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-sdui-manifest`: all exit 0.

<details><summary>New pins and ablation (6 legs, each restored by blob hash)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` per leg, then the four new test files (`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run ...`). All ui test imports resolve `@object-ui/*` from source, so no rebuild between legs.

| Leg (mutation) | Red | Green kept |

| renderer: `if (percentField.percentDisplay === 'plain')` → `if (false)` | 11 of 14 (every `plain` pin on every host) | 3 (bar / absent / blank controls) |
